specialty.name: U.S. Court of Federal Claims
specialty.what: Money claims against the United States: contracts, takings, tax refunds, military pay, vaccine-injury compensation, bid protests.
specialty.appeal: U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit

specialty.name: United States Tax Court
specialty.what: Disputes between taxpayers and the IRS over federal income, estate and gift tax deficiencies, before any tax is paid.
specialty.appeal: The regional court of appeals for the taxpayer’s residence
specialty.authorizedNote: 19 presidentially appointed judges (26 U.S.C. 7443(a)); the roster also lists senior judges recalled to service and special trial judges.

specialty.name: U.S. Court of Appeals for the Armed Forces

specialty.name: U.S. Court of Appeals for Veterans Claims
specialty.what: Appeals from decisions of the Board of Veterans’ Appeals on VA benefits.
specialty.appeal: U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit
specialty.authorizedNote: 7 permanent judgeships (38 U.S.C. 7253(a)); the roster also lists judges recalled from retirement.
